crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

people.name: Jared
people.line: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch

translations.web: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.
translations.bsb: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
translations.kjv: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
translations.asv: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
